title: DEP-SEC: close #280 TS7; block TS>=7 and companion eslint majors
intent: Dependabot #280 (typescript 5.9.3→7.0.2) is unlandable on the current client toolchain (vue-tsc/@volar/typescript ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED for ./lib/tsc; @typescript-eslint v6 Intrinsic failure; Vue SFC regressions). Close it, ignore typescript >=7.0.0 so a future typescript@6 upgrade prepared by #284 remains possible, and also defer/close companion lint majors #282/#283 with eslint/@typescript-eslint semver-major ignores until a coordinated migration PR.
behavior_change: Intake-only. No packages/client version change. Dependabot will not open typescript >=7 or eslint/@typescript-eslint major PRs.

diff_articulation.what_changed: dependabot.yml: ignore typescript versions >=7.0.0; ignore eslint and @typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin|parser semver-majors. Disposition doc records Copilot risk completion, @volar/typescript chain, landing criteria, and close of #280/#282/#283.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Ignoring all typescript majors would also block the intentional TS6 path from #284. Version-scoped TS7 ignore plus companion lint-major ignores are the minimal durable controls. Lockfile-only Dependabot bumps cannot land these.

rg typescript/lib/tsc in packages/client (excl lock) → no repo-local importer
PR #284 body already records #280 unlandable (vue-tsc / eslint / compiler-sfc)
gh pr view 282/283 → CLOSED with deferral comments (external to git)

files.intent: Block TS7 regeneration and freestanding eslint/@typescript-eslint majors.
Authoritative #280 risk disposition and migration criteria.

architecture_scan.acknowledgement_notes: Does not upgrade TypeScript, vue-tsc, or eslint. Closing #280/#282/#283 retains the TS6 migration path from #284 and defers lint majors to a coordinated human PR.
